# Bosco Labs data APIs

> Bosco Labs publishes data tools for AI agents and analysts (HTTP API, remote MCP, x402 and Apify Actors) that return clean, typed JSON from official sources: SEC filings, insider trades, 13F holdings and XBRL financials, US House STOCK Act trades, European ESEF annual reports, UK/Danish/Norwegian company accounts and registries, sanctions lists, EU, UK and Dutch law and case law, EU tenders, US federal and Pentagon contract awards, ECB rates and euro inflation, clinical trials, drug safety, recalls, tariffs, package vulnerabilities and Dutch addresses. 28 tools are live: all 28 HTTP API tools are plain HTTPS endpoints and remote MCP tools that an agent can call with a key (prepaid credits) or without an account, paying per call in USDC via x402 (https://api.boscolabs.dev/v1/<tool>, see API below); 15 of them are also Apify Actors on the Apify Store (pay per event). Data rows carry a source link.

Apify Store profile: https://apify.com/bosco_labs
Contact: support@boscolabs.dev

## Start here (free, no key)

- Plan a question: `curl -s -X POST https://api.boscolabs.dev/v1/plan -H 'content-type: application/json' -d '{"question": "Is Rosneft on the EU sanctions list?"}'` returns the exact call, its input and its maximum price; a question it cannot answer is refused with `not_covered` instead of guessed
- Compact catalogue (one line per tool, ~4 KB): https://api.boscolabs.dev/v1/tools?compact=true
- Claude Code: `claude mcp add --transport http bosco-labs https://api.boscolabs.dev/mcp/free` (planner, tool descriptions, free LEI and SEC lookups); the paid tools are on https://api.boscolabs.dev/mcp with your key
- Cursor: `{"mcpServers": {"bosco-labs": {"url": "https://api.boscolabs.dev/mcp/free"}}}` in `.cursor/mcp.json`

## Finance & SEC

- [SEC Insider Trading API (Form 4): stock transactions since 2006](https://boscolabs.dev/sec-insider-trades.html): Every insider purchase and sale reported on SEC Form 4 (directors, officers, 10% owners), from official EDGAR filings, 2006 to today, with cluster-buy and cluster-sell signals; filter by ticker, CIK, transaction code, role, value and date. Price: Apify Store $0.0018 per transaction row and $0.02 per cluster signal; HTTP API $0.0002 per unit: a Form 4 transaction = 9 units ($0.0018), a cluster signal = 100 ($0.02). ([Apify Store](https://apify.com/bosco_labs/sec-insider-trades))
- [SEC EDGAR Filings API: 8-K, 10-K, 10-Q feed since 1994](https://boscolabs.dev/sec-filings-feed.html): SEC EDGAR filings (8-K, 10-K, 10-Q, S-1, 13D, 13G, Form 4 and every other form) for any company or the whole market, live or back to 1994, from the SEC's own feeds; 8-K item codes and earnings releases (Item 2.02); links to each filing, not its text. Price: Apify Store $0.001 per filing; HTTP API $0.001 per filing. ([Apify Store](https://apify.com/bosco_labs/sec-filings-feed))
- [Congress Stock Trades API: US House STOCK Act since 2014](https://boscolabs.dev/us-house-trades.html): Congress stock trades: stock, option, fund and bond trades that US House members disclose in STOCK Act Periodic Transaction Reports, from the Clerk of the House's official filings since January 2014 (no Senate); ticker, amount range, owner, days to disclose. Price: Apify Store $0.0018 per trade; HTTP API $0.0018 per PTR transaction. ([Apify Store](https://apify.com/bosco_labs/us-house-trades))
- [SEC Ownership API: 13F, N-PORT Fund Holdings, 13D/13G, Form 144](https://boscolabs.dev/sec-ownership.html): Who owns a stock, from official SEC filings: a fund manager's 13F holdings, a mutual fund's or ETF's N-PORT holdings (with changes), the funds holding a ticker, 5%+ stakes (13D/13G) and Form 144 planned insider sales. One ticker or fund in, JSON out, a source link per row. Price: Apify Store $0.0018 per row, plus $0.01 per "who holds this stock" search (13F or N-PORT data set); HTTP API $0.0018 per holding, holder or filing row (one fund or company per call). ([Apify Store](https://apify.com/bosco_labs/sec-ownership))
- [SEC Company Financials API: income, balance sheet, cash flow](https://boscolabs.dev/sec-company-financials.html): US company financial data from SEC EDGAR XBRL: revenue, profit, EPS, balance sheet, cash flow, free cash flow and margins per fiscal year or quarter, 2009 to today. By ticker or CIK, 10-K/10-Q and 20-F filers. Each value cites its XBRL tag and SEC filing. Q4 derived where not reported. Price: Apify Store $0.005 per company-period row; HTTP API $0.005 per company-period row. ([Apify Store](https://apify.com/bosco_labs/sec-company-financials))
- [SEC Company Screener API: filter all US filers by financials](https://boscolabs.dev/sec-company-screen.html): US companies matching your filters for one calendar year or quarter: revenue, net income, margins, cash flow, assets and 30 more metrics from SEC XBRL frames, sorted and capped. Each value cites its XBRL tag and SEC filing. Same metrics as SEC Company Financials. Price: $0.002 per company returned (HTTP API). (HTTP API and MCP)
- [EU Annual Reports API (ESEF): XBRL financial statements](https://boscolabs.dev/esef-annual-reports.html): Normalized key financials (revenue, EBIT, EBITDA, net income, EPS, assets, equity, cash flows, margins, growth) of European listed companies from official ESEF annual reports via filings.xbrl.org; 28 countries; every value linked to its XBRL fact. Price: Apify Store $0.01 per run plus $0.05 per annual report; raw XBRL fact rows, if switched on, $0.0005 each; HTTP API $0.05 per annual report. ([Apify Store](https://apify.com/bosco_labs/esef-annual-reports))
- [ISIN, LEI, CIK, FIGI & Ticker Resolver API (crosswalk)](https://boscolabs.dev/identifier-resolver.html): Issuer legal name, LEI, CIK, tickers, ISINs, FIGIs, CFI code and EU trading venues for one ISIN, LEI, CIK, ticker, FIGI or company name. Check digits validated first; a source URL per value. Data from GLEIF, OpenFIGI, SEC and ESMA FIRDS. Price: Apify Store $0.002 per resolved identifier; HTTP API $0.002 per identifier resolved. ([Apify Store](https://apify.com/bosco_labs/identifier-resolver))

## Companies

- [Company Check API: identity, financials & SEC filings in 1 call](https://boscolabs.dev/company-check.html): Company lookup in one call: legal entity name, LEI, number, status, address, officers and owners, years of financials (revenue, profit, equity), SEC filings for US issuers; UK Companies House charges, appointments and Gazette insolvency. By name, LEI, UK/DK/NO/FR/FI/EE/PL number, ticker or CIK. Price: Apify Store $0.03 per report; HTTP API $0.03 per company report. ([Apify Store](https://apify.com/bosco_labs/company-check))
- [VAT Number & IBAN Check API: EU VIES + IBAN validation](https://boscolabs.dev/vat-iban-check.html): Valid or not for EU VAT numbers (live from the official EU VIES service, with registered name, address and a name match) and IBANs (ISO 13616 check digits, length, bank code, country match). Pass, fail or unverified per check, with the source; unverified and malformed input are free. Price: $0.002 per definite check (VAT number answered by VIES, or a valid IBAN); malformed, failed and unverified are free (HTTP API). (HTTP API and MCP)
- [Company Financials API: UK, Denmark & Norway accounts + LEI](https://boscolabs.dev/company-accounts.html): Financials (revenue, profit, equity, assets, cash, employees) of private and public companies from official accounts: UK Companies House, Denmark Erhvervsstyrelsen, Norway Brønnøysund; adds the LEI from GLEIF and a source per value. Price: Apify Store $0.04 per company-year; HTTP API $0.04 per company-year. ([Apify Store](https://apify.com/bosco_labs/company-accounts))
- [UK New Companies API: daily Companies House incorporations](https://boscolabs.dev/uk-new-companies.html): New UK companies incorporated on any day (default: yesterday) from the official Companies House API: number, name, type, status, SIC codes with descriptions, registered office address and a register link. Filter by SIC prefix, location and type. No director data. Price: $0.002 per company returned (HTTP API). (HTTP API and MCP)
- [Company Hiring Signals API: open roles, departments, locations](https://boscolabs.dev/company-hiring-signals.html): Is a company hiring? Open roles by department, location and remote share, newest and oldest posting dates and top titles, plus job rows with a link each. Read from the company's public Greenhouse, Lever or Ashby job board. Look up by name, domain or board URL. Price: $0.001 per unit: a company summary = 5 units ($0.005), a job row = 1 ($0.001); companies without a public job board are free (HTTP API). (HTTP API and MCP)

## Compliance & law

- [Sanctions Screening API: OFAC, UK, EU, UN & US lists](https://boscolabs.dev/sanctions-screening.html): Sanctions search: is this company, vessel, person or crypto wallet sanctioned? Per name or address: match yes/no, the listed entry, aliases, programs, listing date and a source link, from OFAC SDN and non-SDN, the US Consolidated Screening List, UK, EU and UN Security Council lists. Price: Apify Store $0.01 per name or wallet address screened; HTTP API $0.01 per name or wallet address screened (an address no list could be checked against is free). ([Apify Store](https://apify.com/bosco_labs/sanctions-screening))
- [EU Law Lookup API (EUR-Lex): article text, in force, amendments](https://boscolabs.dev/eu-law-lookup.html): The text of an EU law article as in force today (or on a date), whether the act is in force, what amended it, plus new Official Journal acts. Ask by name (GDPR, AI Act), citation, CELEX or ELI; 24 languages. Official EUR-Lex/Cellar data with a source link per row. Price: Apify Store $0.005 per act or article returned; HTTP API $0.005 per act or article returned. ([Apify Store](https://apify.com/bosco_labs/eu-law-lookup))
- [UK & Dutch Law Lookup API: article text by date, in force](https://boscolabs.dev/national-law-lookup.html): The text of a UK section or Dutch article as in force today (or on a date), whether it is in force and what changed it. Ask by citation: "Companies Act 2006 s 172", "BW 7:658", "artikel 13 Wet Vpb 1969". Official legislation.gov.uk and Dutch BWB data with a source link per row. Price: $0.005 per article or act returned (HTTP API). (HTTP API and MCP)
- [Dutch Case Law API (Rechtspraak): ECLI lookup, uitspraken](https://boscolabs.dev/dutch-case-law.html): Dutch court decisions (uitspraken) by ECLI or search: court, dates, case numbers, legal area, summary (inhoudsindicatie), appeal/cassation relations, law references and optional text. Hoge Raad, Raad van State, gerechtshoven, rechtbanken. Official Rechtspraak Open Data, source link per row. Price: $0.005 per court decision returned (HTTP API). (HTTP API and MCP)
- [US Federal Rules API: CFR text as of a date + Federal Register](https://boscolabs.dev/us-federal-rules.html): The text of a CFR section as in force today or on any date, its amendment history and the Federal Register rules that changed it; what changed in a CFR part since a date; Federal Register documents by number or search. Official eCFR and FederalRegister.gov data, a source link per row. Price: Apify Store $0.005 per section, $0.002 per document; HTTP API $0.001 per unit: a CFR section with text = 5 units ($0.005), a Federal Register document = 2 ($0.002); rows without text are free. ([Apify Store](https://apify.com/bosco_labs/us-federal-rules))
- [Product Recall Check API: CPSC, NHTSA, FDA & EU Safety Gate](https://boscolabs.dev/product-recalls.html): Recalled yes/no, with each recall's date, hazard, remedy and official link, for a product name, brand, model, UPC/EAN or VIN. Checks US CPSC, NHTSA vehicle recalls, FDA enforcement reports (food, drugs, devices) and EU Safety Gate in one call. Lists every source checked. Price: $0.005 per product checked (every source answered) (HTTP API). (HTTP API and MCP)
- [Tariff Code & Duty Lookup API: US HTS and UK Tariff](https://boscolabs.dev/tariff-lookup.html): Import duty rates for a US Harmonized Tariff Schedule (HTS) or UK commodity code: official description hierarchy, general/MFN rate, preferential rates, US Chapter 99 references, UK VAT, units, source link. Or a product description in, 5 official candidate codes out. No binding ruling. Price: Apify Store $0.005 per lookup or search; HTTP API $0.005 per code lookup or code search (US or UK). ([Apify Store](https://apify.com/bosco_labs/tariff-lookup))

## Government & procurement

- [EU Public Tenders & Contract Awards API (TED procurement)](https://boscolabs.dev/eu-tenders.html): EU public procurement notices from TED (Tenders Electronic Daily), the EU's official tenders journal: open calls with deadlines, contract awards with winners and values, prior information; EU, EEA and more, since 2016; filter by keyword, country, CPV code, notice type, date, EUR value. Price: Apify Store $0.002 per notice; HTTP API $0.002 per TED notice. ([Apify Store](https://apify.com/bosco_labs/eu-tenders))
- [Pentagon / DoD Contract Awards API: winners, amounts, tickers](https://boscolabs.dev/dod-contract-awards.html): US Department of Defense contract awards of $7.5M or more the same evening they are announced, plus USAspending.gov history since FY2008 (any federal agency); winner, amount, service, NAICS/PSC, matched to a US stock ticker with SEC shares outstanding. Price: $0.005 per award row (USAspending history) (HTTP API). (HTTP API and MCP)
- [US Federal Awards API: contracts & grants, all agencies](https://boscolabs.dev/us-federal-awards.html): US federal contract, grant and loan awards from every agency (USAspending.gov): winner, UEI, parent company, stock ticker, agency, amounts, dates, NAICS/PSC/assistance listing, place of performance and a source link. Filter by company, ticker, agency, keyword, state, date. Price: $0.004 per award row (HTTP API). (HTTP API and MCP)

## Macro, health & places

- [ECB Rates & Euro Inflation API: policy rates, FX, €STR, HICP](https://boscolabs.dev/eu-rates-inflation.html): Latest value, previous value, change and recent history of ECB policy rates, euro reference FX rates, €STR, euro-area and national bond yields, and Eurostat HICP inflation. Ask by plain name (ecb_deposit_rate, eur_fx:USD, hicp:NL), no SDMX keys. Official data, a source link per series. Price: $0.002 per series returned (catalogue free) (HTTP API). (HTTP API and MCP)
- [ClinicalTrials.gov API: trial search & NCT dossier](https://boscolabs.dev/clinical-trials.html): Clinical trials as compact JSON rows: status, phase, sponsor, conditions, interventions, enrollment, start and primary completion dates, countries, outcomes and results. Look up NCT numbers or search by condition, drug, sponsor, phase, status, country and dates. Sourced, no contact data. Price: $0.004 per trial (HTTP API). (HTTP API and MCP)
- [Drug Safety API: FDA label, FAERS, recalls, EMA status](https://boscolabs.dev/drug-safety.html): Drug safety dossier for one drug name as one sourced JSON row: FDA boxed warning and indications, top FAERS adverse reaction counts, US recalls and shortages (openFDA), EU authorisation, EPAR link and EU shortages (EMA). Or one cheaper sub-query. Not medical advice. Price: Apify Store $0.02 per dossier or $0.004 per single-section query; HTTP API $0.004 per sub-query; a full dossier = 5 units ($0.02); partial answers are free. ([Apify Store](https://apify.com/bosco_labs/drug-safety))
- [Dutch Address Lookup API: BAG postcode, geocode & building data](https://boscolabs.dev/dutch-address-lookup.html): Validates and geocodes Dutch addresses against the official BAG register (via PDOK): postcode, BAG ids, WGS84 + RD coordinates, construction year, use, floor area and building status. Free text, postcode + house number (or range) or BAG ids; up to 100 per run. Unmatched inputs are free. Price: $0.002 per address resolved (unresolved inputs are free) (HTTP API). (HTTP API and MCP)

## Software security

- [Package Vulnerability Check API: CVEs, CISA KEV, safe upgrade](https://boscolabs.dev/package-vulns.html): Known vulnerabilities in a package version (npm, PyPI, Maven, Go, crates.io, NuGet, RubyGems, Packagist) or one CVE/GHSA id: severity, CVSS, fixed versions, CISA KEV exploited status and the lowest safe upgrade; for a CVE also the affected packages. From OSV.dev and CISA, a source link per advisory. Price: $0.005 per package version or CVE answered (HTTP API). (HTTP API and MCP)

## How to call

- Apify API (synchronous): POST `https://api.apify.com/v2/acts/bosco_labs~<actor>/run-sync-get-dataset-items` with header `Authorization: Bearer <APIFY_TOKEN>` and the Actor input as the JSON body; the response is the dataset items.
- Apify hosted MCP server: add `https://mcp.apify.com?tools=bosco_labs/<actor>` to your MCP client (Claude, Cursor, VS Code, ...). It loads the Actor as a tool plus `get-actor-run` and `get-dataset-items`, and signs you in with OAuth or `Authorization: Bearer <APIFY_TOKEN>`. On the default server (`https://mcp.apify.com`) agents can also find the Actors with `search-actors` and run them with `call-actor`.
- Pricing: pay per event, billed to your own Apify account: you pay for rows delivered at the prices listed per Actor, and runs stop at your max charge limit.
- Bosco Labs HTTP API: `POST https://api.boscolabs.dev/v1/<tool>` with `Authorization: Bearer <key>` for every tool listed with an API price (same input and rows as the Actors), prepaid credits, $0.50 free trial, or no key and pay per call in USDC via x402; remote MCP at `https://api.boscolabs.dev/mcp`. Keys, prices and limits: https://boscolabs.dev/api.html
- Contact: support@boscolabs.dev (questions, data issues, custom data requests).
- Bosco Labs MCP server: `bosco-labs-data-mcp` on PyPI (https://pypi.org/project/bosco-labs-data-mcp/) and the official MCP Registry (`io.github.Bosco-Labs/bosco-labs-data`): one MCP server for all data Actors. Run it with `uvx bosco-labs-data-mcp` and set `APIFY_TOKEN`; source in https://github.com/Bosco-Labs/bosco-labs-data/tree/main/mcp.

## API (beta)

- Base URL: https://api.boscolabs.dev; `POST /v1/<tool>` with header `Authorization: Bearer <key>` (or `X-API-Key`) and the Actor's input object as JSON body; the response holds the Actor's rows plus `charged_usd` and `balance_usd`.
- OpenAPI: https://api.boscolabs.dev/openapi.json; interactive docs: https://api.boscolabs.dev/docs; catalogue with prices and input schemas: https://api.boscolabs.dev/v1/tools (free)
- Not sure which tool? `POST https://api.boscolabs.dev/v1/plan` with `{"question": "..."}` (free, no key) returns the exact calls with their input and maximum price; `GET https://api.boscolabs.dev/v1/tools/<tool>` describes one tool (free); `POST https://api.boscolabs.dev/v1/run` with the plan_id and a required `max_usd` runs the plan on your key (each step charged like a direct call). On MCP: plan_official_records_query, describe_official_records_tool, run_official_records_plan.
- Remote MCP (streamable HTTP, same key header): https://api.boscolabs.dev/mcp
- [Get a key, prices and limits](https://boscolabs.dev/api.html): prepaid credits, packs $10, $50, $200, one-time $0.50 free trial per verified e-mail; prices include VAT
- x402, no account (https://boscolabs.dev/api.html#x402): call `POST /v1/<tool>` without a key to get `402 Payment Required` (x402 v2) and pay per call in USDC on Base mainnet (eip155:8453); schemes `upto` (settles only what was delivered: rows x price, min $0.005) and `exact` (settles the quote: bound it with maxResults; keyless calls default to 10 rows) are offered; with `upto` a wallet needs only USDC on Base (gasless permit, no ETH). Nothing is settled on an error or empty result (`404 no_results`). Prices = https://api.boscolabs.dev/v1/tools. Example agent: https://github.com/Bosco-Labs/bosco-labs-data/tree/main/examples/x402-agent
- x402 payment details: payTo 0x7bcb52707d5C4f334ad0D2548f96a0419fa6203F (USDC on Base); facilitator: Coinbase CDP. The `facilitatorAddress` in a 402 rotates within CDP's own set of addresses, so it can differ from a Bazaar listing; every address CDP hands out is valid.
- [Account](https://boscolabs.dev/account.html): a key's balance, today's spend against its daily cap and its last 20 ledger rows (`GET /v1/me`, `GET /v1/me/usage`), credit top-ups, and a new key for a lost one (same e-mail: a link that issues a new key and revokes the old one; balance kept)
- [Privacy](https://boscolabs.dev/privacy.html): request bodies (names screened, queries) are never logged or stored
- [Terms](https://boscolabs.dev/terms.html): prepaid credits, 14-day refunds, data is information with a source link, not advice
- [Trust](https://boscolabs.dev/security.html): read-only tools, sources and licences, sanctions screening limits, untrusted text in results
- [Status](https://boscolabs.dev/status.html): daily check of every tool against its source and the version date of every sanctions list (JSON: https://s1uqkufag2x3nhpu.public.blob.vercel-storage.com/status/status.json)
- `company-check`: $0.03 per company report (max 1 report).
- `vat-iban-check`: $0.002 per definite check (VAT number answered by VIES, or a valid IBAN); malformed, failed and unverified are free (max 10 VAT numbers and 50 IBANs). VAT answers: EU VIES (European Commission); IBAN layouts: SWIFT IBAN Registry.
- `sec-company-financials`: $0.005 per company-period row (max 10 tickers/CIKs x 20 years).
- `sec-company-screen`: $0.002 per company returned (max 200 companies (maxResults)).
- `sec-filings-feed`: $0.001 per filing (max 200 filings (maxResults)).
- `sanctions-screening`: $0.01 per name or wallet address screened (an address no list could be checked against is free) (max 50 names and 50 addresses). This product uses the International Trade Administration's Data API but is not endorsed or certified by the International Trade Administration. OFAC and CSL data are US government works. UK Sanctions List: contains public sector information licensed under the Open Government Licence v3.0. EU list: European Commission, names as published. No endorsement by any publisher is implied.
- `eu-law-lookup`: $0.005 per act or article returned (max 50 results (maxResults)). Consolidated texts from EUR-Lex (© European Union) are a documentation tool with no legal effect; only the acts published in the Official Journal of the European Union are authentic.
- `national-law-lookup`: $0.005 per article or act returned (max 5 articles). UK: contains public sector information licensed under the Open Government Licence v3.0 (© Crown and database right, legislation.gov.uk).
- `eu-rates-inflation`: $0.002 per series returned (catalogue free) (max 20 series). Source: ECB statistics (data.ecb.europa.eu). The data are free of charge from the ECB; we charge for processing and delivery, not for the data. Eurostat HICP: © European Union, free of charge from Eurostat. The change field is computed by Bosco Labs.
- `us-federal-rules`: $0.001 per unit: a CFR section with text = 5 units ($0.005), a Federal Register document = 2 ($0.002); rows without text are free (max 10 CFR units or 50 documents).
- `drug-safety`: $0.004 per sub-query; a full dossier = 5 units ($0.02); partial answers are free (max 1 drug).
- `product-recalls`: $0.005 per product checked (every source answered) (max 20 products).
- `package-vulns`: $0.005 per package version or CVE answered (max 1 check).
- `identifier-resolver`: $0.002 per identifier resolved (max 1 identifier).
- `clinical-trials`: $0.004 per trial (max 100 trials (maxResults) or 100 NCT numbers).
- `company-hiring-signals`: $0.001 per unit: a company summary = 5 units ($0.005), a job row = 1 ($0.001); companies without a public job board are free (max 5 companies x 200 jobs).
- `dutch-address-lookup`: $0.002 per address resolved (unresolved inputs are free) (max 50 addresses/BAG ids or 1 postcode (100 addresses)). BAG data (Kadaster, via PDOK): Public Domain Mark 1.0. No endorsement by Kadaster or PDOK implied.
- `dutch-case-law`: $0.005 per court decision returned (max 25 ECLIs + 25 search results (maxResults)). Rechtspraak Open Data; no copyright on court decisions (art. 11 Auteurswet). The published decision on rechtspraak.nl is the reference text; not legal advice.
- `uk-new-companies`: $0.002 per company returned (max 200 companies (maxResults)). UK: contains public sector information licensed under the Open Government Licence v3.0 (Companies House).
- `eu-tenders`: $0.002 per TED notice (max 200 notices (maxResults)).
- `us-federal-awards`: $0.004 per award row (max 100 awards (maxResults)).
- `dod-contract-awards`: $0.005 per award row (USAspending history) (max 100 awards (maxResults)).
- `us-house-trades`: $0.0018 per PTR transaction (max 200 trades (maxResults)).
- `sec-insider-trades`: $0.0002 per unit: a Form 4 transaction = 9 units ($0.0018), a cluster signal = 100 ($0.02) (max 5 tickers/CIKs x 183 days, 200 rows (maxResults)).
- `company-accounts`: $0.04 per company-year (max 5 companies, 10 years per country (maxResults)).
- `esef-annual-reports`: $0.05 per annual report (max 10 reports (maxFilings)).
- `sec-ownership`: $0.0018 per holding, holder or filing row (one fund or company per call) (max 200 rows (maxResults)).
- `tariff-lookup`: $0.005 per code lookup or code search (US or UK) (max 1 code or 5 candidates).

## Optional

- [llms-full.txt](https://boscolabs.dev/llms-full.txt): input fields, output fields and an example input for every Actor
